structured.reason: Dropping None-valued keys before parsing lets values like {"a": null} pass a schema whose optional "a" must be a string, which weakens router-side validation. It also changes the parsed value, from {'a': None} to {} in the confirmed run, so the requested model is no longer rebuilt faithfully from valid JSON output.
